data.segment_title: Campaign 2008 / Obama vs. McCain / The Campaign
data.segment_description:
(Studio: Charles Gibson)  The standings of presidential candidates Senators Barack Obama and John McCain in the latest ABC News/"Washington Post" poll cited.  

(Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania: Jake Tapper)  Obama's campaign in Ohio and Pennsylvania featured; scenes shown from Canton, Ohio; poll figures cited.  [OBAMA&nbsp- says McCain still cannot tell the people what he would different from President Bush on the economy; states there is the united states of America and we need to restore our sense of purpose; notes we have a lot of work to do.]  [Democratic strategist Tad DEVINE†- warns against over confidence.]  

(Pottsville, Pennsylvania: Ron Claiborne)  McCain's campaign featured.  [McCAIN&nbsp- says the difference is Obama thinks taxes have been too low; criticizes Obama over a redistribution of wealth.]  [In 2001, on Chicago WBEZ radio, OBAMA&nbsp- says a tragedy of the civil rights movement was....]  [Penn State University professor Michael BERKMAN†- outlines why the McCain camp has some hope in the state.]  McCain's theme of leadership and experience noted.
(Studio: Charles Gibson)  Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms report on the foiling of a plot by two skinheads in Tennessee targeting Senator Barack Obama and 102 African Americans reported.

(Studio: Charles Gibson)  Report introduced.   (Washington: Pierre Thomas)  The conviction of Republican Alaska Senator Ted Stevens on seven counts of corruption reviewed; courtroom sketches by William Hennessey shown; details given about the prosecution's case about undisclosed gifts and home renovations by Veco oil; excerpt of a phone conversation between Stevens and Veco's Bill Allen played.   (Studio: Charles Gibson)  Stevens' plans to appeal the verdict and remain as a Senate candidate noted.

(Studio: Charles Gibson)  Another drop in the US and Asian stock markets and another drop in gasoline and oil prices reported; statistics cited.   (New York: David Muir)  The winners and losers when the gas and heating prices drop featured; examples cited; details given about the impact on oil countries like Venezuela and Iran and on alternative energy sources.  [New Jersey motorist Dale BELL; home heating oil buyer Elizabeth PHEE‡; shelter food deliverer Victor GONZALEZ; City Harvest vice president Jennifer McLEAN†- react to fuel prices.]  [PFC Energy chairman Robin WEST†- says renewables are threatened by these low prices.]

(Studio: Charles Gibson; Pentagon: Jonathan Karl)  US precision attacks inside Syria targeting an Iraqi man named Abu Ghadiya††, who headed an effort to funnel foreign fighters into Iraq, and the blunt message to Syria and this pattern of covert attacks into Syria, Pakistan and Somalia discussed.
(Studio: Charles Gibson)  A report from Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad that he is suffering from exhaustion reported.

(Studio: Charles Gibson)  The confirmation of the death of singer/actress Jennifer Hudson's nephew Julian King, who had been missing since the murder of her mother and brother last Friday, reported.  

(Chicago: Barbara Pinto)  The Hudson family tragedy featured; scenes shown from the Hudson family house.  [Cousin Rev. Crista ALSTON†- comments on this devastation to the family.]  Photo shown of Julian's stepfather William Balfour†.  [Neighbor Rose SIMPSON†, family friend Necey REED†- comment on Julian and mom in the neighborhood.]  [At the Golden Globes, HUDSON&nbsp- acknowledges her mother.]  The soaring murder rate in Chicago noted.
(Studio: Charles Gibson)  FBI raids across the country against child prostitution in Operation Cross Country II reported.
